notes: Variant WLC.DEU.33.2.v001 resolved to r00-base, which supplies s025 and s026; the ASV's a fiery law is aligned against that reading.

At his right hand was ... is read as a prepositional predicate under rule 49; the competing reading would put was on the subject noun law. The Hebrew clause has an indefinite nominal and a fronted locative, so the preposition is the predicate.
mount Paran keeps the attributive construct rendering under rule 28; ten thousands and holy ones head on the lexeme-bearing words under rule 31.
